title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 373 (Suits stayed on winding up order)

content.overview: Where an order has been made for winding up a company registered in pursuance of this Part, no suit or other legal proceeding shall be proceeded with or commenced against the company or any contributory of the company in respect of any debt of the company, except by leave of the Tribunal and subject to such terms as the Tribunal may impose.
content.glance: After winding-up order of a company registered under this Part, suits against the company or contributories for company debts require Tribunal leave.
